answer: Peer-arrival compute tax: each ID blocks on one upstream neighbor's hash, redrawn every 400 ms like a pearl in a slot. Rule: under 8 distinct upstreams in 5 s gates your next 20 txs, like a river choking a channel. Attacker cost: N nodes pay 5 s wall-clock plus 8-stream bandwidth each, no zephyr of free parallelism.
